        char[] chars = s.toCharArray();

        int[] vals = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            vals[i] = scanner.nextInt();
        }
        scanner.nextLine();

        List<Integer> wrongIndices = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Char> charList = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
            boolean wrong = false;
            if (chars[i] == chars[n - i - 1]) {
                if (vals[i] > vals[n - i - 1]) {
                    swap(chars, vals, i, n - i - 1);
                }
                wrong = true;
            }
            Char c = new Char(chars[i], vals[i], i);
            if (wrong) wrongIndices.add(i);
            charList.add(c);
        }
        charList.sort(Comparator.comparing(c -> c.val));

        int totalSum = Arrays.stream(vals).sum();
        int diff = 0;

        if (!isAntiPalindrome(chars)) {
            if (wrongIndices.size() == 1) {
                int wrongIdx = wrongIndices.get(0);
                Char wrongChar = new Char(chars[wrongIdx], vals[wrongIdx], wrongIdx);
                for (Char c : charList) {
                    if (c.chr != wrongChar.chr && chars[n - c.idx - 1] != wrongChar.chr) {
                        diff = wrongChar.val + c.val;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            } else if (wrongIndices.size() > 1) {
                Map<Character, Integer> countMap = new HashMap<>();
                for (int idx : wrongIndices) {
                    countMap.put(chars[idx], countMap.getOrDefault(chars[idx], 0) + 1);
                }
                int maxCount = Collections.max(countMap.values());
                List<Char> appendChars = new ArrayList<>();
                while (maxCount * 2 > wrongIndices.size() + appendChars.size()) {
                    Character maxChar = Collections.max(countMap.entrySet(), Map.Entry.comparingByValue()).getKey();

                            appendChars.add(c);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                int sumWrong = wrongIndices.stream().mapToInt(i -> vals[i]).sum();
                int sumAppend = appendChars.stream().mapToInt(c -> c.val).sum();
                diff = sumWrong + sumAppend;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(totalSum - diff);

    private static void swap(char[] chars, int[] vals, int i, int j) {
        char tmpChar = chars[i];
        chars[i] = chars[j];
        chars[j] = tmpChar;

        int tmpVal = vals[i];
        vals[i] = vals[j];
        vals[j] = tmpVal;
    }

    private static boolean isAntiPalindrome(char[] arr) {
        int len = arr.length;
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            if (arr[i] == arr[len - i - 1]) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;

        int idx;
